manual_review.method: Tukey 1.5 IQR upper fence on calibration-only translation fit residuals
manual_review.conclusion: 排除 c02、c19；仅依据标定集内部残差，未使用线速度测试结果选点。

limitations: Lag resolution is bounded by controller frame cadence despite the 1 ms search step.
Controller intervals above the configured gap limit are excluded from velocity correlation.
Lag uses the controller motion principal axis so unverified device axes cannot bias time alignment.
The current tracking-session origin is reconstructed from the stationary warmup.

trajectory_diagnostics.robot_interpolation: 100 Hz feedback interpolated at controller timestamps
trajectory_diagnostics.alignment_source: controller principal-axis position alignment; robot query = controller time - lag

invalid_cross_session.reason: T_BW belongs to the calibration tracking session and was applied to a different velocity-test session

session_anchor.method: stationary 0.2-1.5 s warmup rigid re-anchor; diagnostic only

shape_fit.method: motion-only Kabsch rigid registration after timestamp alignment; diagnostic only

action_chunk_horizon_error.definition: one fixed clock alignment; one start-pose alignment per window; no per-window lag search, whole-window fit, or endpoint alignment

classification.motion_definition: mean ground-truth path speed above stationary threshold

clock_alignment.source: single global position/velocity correlation before windowing
